Definition: Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kedesh is the name of four places, and the most famous is Kedesh in Galilee: they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, a city of refuge; Deborah sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali. The king of Kedesh was one of the one and thirty kings Joshua smote.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the city of refuge is the Kedesh that matters most, because it is where a manslayer could run and live.
